description: This file contains an extension of the ChannelsSettings class, providing helper functions for parsing dates from milliseconds and decoding QR code images from data URLs.

methods.name: date(fromMs:)
methods.description: Converts a Double in milliseconds to a Date object, returning nil if input is nil.

methods.name: qrImage(from:)
methods.description: Decodes a Data URL containing a base64-encoded image into an NSImage object.
